knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A saturated pad spreads soil; a clean, damp pad taken out of the charging bucket restores lifting power.
The white backing faces up so that the microfiber side takes up the solution.
Excess product can leave a film and make the floor slippery, so the label dose is used.

practicalCriteria: Loads the charging bucket with the right number of pads, white backing up, and seals the lid.
Replaces a saturated pad rather than rinsing it on the floor.
Returns the bucket and holder, then rinses and stores the pads and bucket.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Job record or photo of the finished area
stopWorkCriteria: Pad rinsed on the floor during mopping
Charging bucket carried with the lid unsealed
Cleaner dosed well above the label
